FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE VADAMARADCHI SOUTHWEST PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONSORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Vadamaradchi South West Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason ofResignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Ahila Ilankai Thamil Congress, the recognized political party to whichRasaiya Sivarani the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decideupon returned member if Ahila Ilankai Thamil Congress who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under Section9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period of thirty(30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision tonominate Selvarathinam Mallikathevi to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Rajendram Christy Amalraaj, Returning Officer of the Vadamaradchi South PradeshiyaSabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declarethat Selvarathinam Mallikathevi was selected as the member of the Vadamaradchi South West Pradeshiya Sabha.
R. C. AMALRAAJ,Returning Officer,Vadamaradchi South West Pradeshiya Sabha.District Election Office,Jaffna,03rd May, 2019.

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE VADAMARADCHI SOUTHWEST PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONSORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Vadamaradchi South West Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason ofResignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Ahila Ilankai Thamil Congress, the recognized political party to whichSivarasa Sivarathi the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decideupon returned member if Ahila Ilankai Thamil Congress who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under Section9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period of thirty(30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision tonominate Vijayabahu Rajeswary to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Rajendram Christy Amalraaj, Returning Officer of the Vadamaradchi South WestPradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) dohereby declare that Vijayabahu Rajeswary was selected as the member of the Vadamaradchi South West Pradeshiya Sabha.
